system.description:
You are adept at creating convincing disguises in remarkably short periods of time.

Prerequisites: Trained in Deception, Charisma 13

Effect: You gain a +5 insight bonus to your Deception check when creating a Deceptive Appearance. In addition, you can rush the process by taking a -2 penalty to the Deception check.

Normal: When you rush the creation of a Deceptive Appearance, you take a -10 penalty to your Deception check.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
